jobs.summaryAngle: AI Application Trainee looking for a supervised, part-time chance to implement AI solutions with engineers and business stakeholders.
letter: I am applying for the part-time Forward Deployed Engineer Intern role in Kowloon Bay. I am an AI Application Trainee in a Department of Physics. My current project is an AI chatbot for a robot, which I also demonstrate at the College of Science Information Day.

The public listing says the intern works with technical experts and business stakeholders to design, develop, and implement AI solutions, and that the work includes AI, data, and automation. That matches how I already spend the role. I compare AI models and server-tunnelling setups because a demo fails if the answer is wrong or if the reply is too slow. I test the robot application in an Android simulation environment, use Cursor and Claude Code to trace faults, and then run the same path as a first-time user. A flow can look finished to the person who built it and still break for someone else.

I would like the mentorship described in the listing, and the chance to turn that testing habit into solutions other teams can use. Please treat this as a draft. The full JobsDB text was not available when this letter was written on 6 October 2026, and my profile does not yet record enrolment status, degree, or contact details. I will add those, and I will not submit this application unless I am eligible for a student internship.

jobs.summaryAngle: AI Application Trainee seeking a first full-time role that pairs structured training with delivery of AI solutions.
letter: I am applying for the Forward Deployed Engineer Associate, AI and Data, role at Ricoh Hong Kong. I am an AI Application Trainee in a Department of Physics, and I am looking for a full-time role that still has structured training.

I build an AI chatbot for a robot and show it at the College of Science Information Day. Before a demonstration I test combinations of models and server-tunnelling configurations, because accuracy and response time both have to hold with an audience watching. I also test the robot application in an Android simulation environment. Cursor and Claude Code shorten the debugging, but I still re-run the journey as a user. That is the check that catches a design which only makes sense to the person who wrote it.

Your card describes working beside technical experts and business stakeholders, with mentorship and hands-on AI, cloud, and digital work. I can bring the chatbot project, the test habit, and the willingness to learn the cloud tools the full advertisement requires. This draft uses the company-list summary retrieved on 6 October 2026. I will read the full JobsDB text, add my degree and contact details, and only then decide to apply. If I am still enrolled, the part-time intern posting is the better fit.

jobs.summaryAngle: AI Application Trainee who tests robot software and an on-robot chatbot, interested in a surgical-robotics internship if the C++ requirement can be met.
letter: I am writing about the AI Engineer Intern role at Precision Robotics in Hong Kong Science Park. I am an AI Application Trainee in a Department of Physics. I test robot applications and an AI chatbot that runs with a robot, including demonstrations at the College of Science Information Day.

The duties that match my current work are testing, verification, debugging, and documentation. I spend most weekdays on the robot application and its Android simulation. I compare AI models and server-tunnelling setups so answers stay accurate and responses stay fast. Cursor and Claude Code help me find faults, and I still retest as a user because a designer can miss what a clinician or a visitor will stumble on. I can document what failed and what changed.

I should be clear about the gap. The aggregator listing requires good C++ knowledge, and C++ is not in my recorded work. Python and Java are not recorded either. I will not send this letter unless I can show coursework or a project that meets that bar, and unless Precision Robotics still has the internship open. The page I used was a third-party copy read on 6 October 2026, with no posting date.
